units.source_text: 从室内温泉出来，只见一个叫卖的俄国女人坐在大门口。

en.t: Coming out of the indoor hot spring, he saw a Russian woman selling things sitting by the entrance.

units.source_text: 她为什么竟会到这样的穷乡僻壤来呢？

en.t: Why on earth had she come to such a remote backwater?

units.source_text: 岛村走过去一看，尽是些常见的日本化妆品和发饰一类的东西。

en.t: When Shimamura went over and looked, they were all ordinary Japanese cosmetics and hair ornaments.
